'''Harzoon Parr''' was a researcher with the [[Galactic History Foundation]]. Parr proposed that the [[ibliton]] of [[Randorn 2]] was planted on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by an ancient starfaring [[Species/Legends|species]]; however, this remained merely a theory.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
